Bill.BriefDescription: Convening a work group to develop a standardized clinical affiliation agreement for clinical placements for physicians and nurses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to convening a work group to develop a standardizedclinical affiliation agreement for clinical placements associated withthe education of physicians and nurses; adding a new section to chapter43.70 RCW; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall convene a work group to study andrecommend language for standardized clinical affiliation agreements forclinical placements associated with the education and training ofphysicians licensed under chapter 18.71 RCW, osteopathic physicians andsurgeons licensed under chapter 18.57 RCW, and nurses licensed underchapter 18.79 RCW. (2) When choosing members of the work group, the department shallconsult with the health care personnel shortage task force and shallattempt to ensure that the membership of the work group isgeographically diverse. The work group must, at a minimum, includerepresentatives of the following: (a) Twoyear institutions of higher education; p. 1 HB 1660 (b) Fouryear institutions of higher education; (c) The University of Washington medical school; (d) The college of osteopathic medicine at the Pacific NorthwestUniversity of Health Sciences; (e) The health care personnel shortage task force; (f) Statewide organizations representing hospitals and otherfacilities that accept clinical placements; (g) A statewide organization representing physicians; (h) A statewide organization representing osteopathic physiciansand surgeons; (i) A statewide organization representing nurses; (j) A labor organization representing nurses; and (k) Any other groups deemed appropriate by the department inconsultation with the health care personnel shortage task force. (3) The work group shall develop one recommended standardizedclinical affiliation agreement for each profession or one recommendedstandardized clinical affiliation agreement for all three professions.The work group shall report its findings to the governor and theappropriate standing committees of the legislature no later thanNovember 15, 2014. (4) This section expires July 1, 2015.
